message.reasoning_content: Record description update. Key risk: A&S approximation max error ~1e-7 in erfc but composed with GELU — tolerance 1e-6 absolute; classic A&S 7.1.26 has absolute error < 7.5e-8 in Phi, times x up to 65504 — huge! Also exp(-x²/2) underflow for |x|>~27 fine (0). But GELU for large positive x should be x; 1-tail where tail→0 fine. For large negative x, GELU→0; tail→0? polynomial*exp small... t→1/(0.327*65504*0.707) small, polynomial → -0.28450? Wait Horner ends polynomial*=-0.28450... actually last step polynomial*t+0.25483 then *t: at t→0 polynomial→0? Horner: p=1.06141t-1.45315; p=p*t+1.42141... final p=p*t after +0.25483. At t=0, p→0. Fine. Main risk: error in Phi ~ up to ~7e-8? Actually A&S 7.1.26 error in erfc is <1.5e-7 absolute. Multiplied by |x| up to 65504 → up to ~0.01 absolute error — far exceeds 1e-6. Even at moderate |x|~4, error ~6e-7 borderline. So risk: tolerance violation for moderate/large |x|.
